title: Chouette à voir!
specs: 27 species of Quebec birds of prey including 5 vulnerable species
Flight demonstrations twice daily at 11:00 am and 2:00 pm
Rehabilitation complex with 9 aviaries for birds to practice flying before release
Bird on fist experience age minimum: 5 years for small birds, 10 years for medium, 16 years for large birds
Birds of Prey Identification Workshop minimum age: 10 years
Half-day biologist trainer activity minimum age: 12 years
Reservations possible for groups of 10 or more including school groups and ornithology clubs
Corporate and travel groups accommodated with adapted schedules and demonstrations
Other groups: ornithologists, day camps, scout groups, municipal citizen activities
includes: Demonstrations of birds of prey in flight
Use of equipment and instructions for bird on fist experience
Entry to site included in workshop and photography session prices
blurb: Guests observe and learn about 27 species of Quebec birds of prey through flight demonstrations, guided tours of a rehabilitation complex, and interactive exhibits. Activities include hiking trails, thematic kiosks, and special events such as night safaris and photography sessions. The site operates seasonally with various programs and offers group and corporate visits.
extraNote: Tickets are non-refundable and non-exchangeable · Admission is free for residents with online reservation and proof of residence · Events postponed to next day if weather is bad; ticket valid for rescheduled date · Reservation mandatory for all visits · Chouette à Voir! site in Saint-Jude · June through October main season; open year-round with reduced schedule
